groups.title: Multi-Cloud DR Architecture Patterns
groups.question: Explain the main ways to design disaster recovery across two cloud providers.

followUps.Active-Active vs Active-Passive Across C: What are the trade-offs between active-active and active-passive DR across clouds?
followUps.DNS-Based Traffic Failover Between Cloud: Why does DNS TTL matter for cross-cloud failover, and what does keeping it low cost you?

groups.title: Kubernetes DR with Velero
groups.question: Walk through how you would back up and recover Kubernetes workloads so they survive losing a whole cloud.

followUps.Velero for Cross-Cloud Kubernetes Backup: Why store Velero backups in more than one cloud, and what does Velero restore that IaC alone cannot?
followUps.Chaos Engineering for Multi-Cloud Resili: How would you prove with chaos experiments that failover to the other cloud really works?

groups.title: RPO and RTO for Multi-Cloud
groups.question: Explain how you would set and meet recovery point and recovery time targets across clouds.

followUps.Data Synchronization Strategies for Low: What is the trade-off between synchronous and asynchronous replication between clouds?
followUps.Automated DR Runbooks with AWS Systems M: How do automated DR runbooks shorten recovery time, and what makes cross-cloud runbooks risky?

groups.title: DR Testing and Validation
groups.question: Explain how you would keep confidence that a multi-cloud DR plan still works over time.

followUps.Conducting Quarterly Multi-Cloud DR Dril: What should a DR drill measure, and how do you use the results from one drill to the next?
followUps.Service Level Agreements for Multi-Cloud: Why should the RTO and RPO you promise customers come from drill results instead of design targets?
